t: Fuqi International - Wikipedia
s: August 26, 2025 - Fuqi International (formerly traded as Nasdaq: FUQI) is a designer of precious metal (gold and platinum) jewelry for the luxury goods market in China. It also manufactures jewelry items that contain diamonds and other precious stones on a custom-order basis. Fuqi is a Delaware corporation with its principal executive office located in Shenzhen, China.
